title:
From idea
to evidence.
benefit: An AI engineer’s workflow in one local workspace.
lines: AI engineering is more than writing a prompt.
You need to run experiments, understand failures, and prove that a change helps.
Here is that workflow inside AI Engineering IDE.

captions.text: AI engineering is more than writing a prompt.

Here is that workflow inside AI Engineering IDE.

title:
Start with
the wiring.
benefit: Templates, project commands, and local history share one workspace.
lines: Start in Overview with an existing Python project, or choose an instrumented template.
Python, LangGraph, RAG, and training templates provide a starting point.
For this demo, we have prepared a small support-answer project and its local commands.

captions.text: Start in Overview with an existing Python project, or choose an instrumented template.

title:
Run it.
Measure it.
benefit: A completed process can still produce a wrong answer.
lines: In Runs, select baseline and run it locally.
The process completes, but the answer correctness score is zero.
This example deliberately uses deterministic retrieval, without a language model, so we can isolate the retrieval mistake.

captions.text: In Runs, select baseline and run it locally.

title:
Find the
wrong step.
benefit: Nested spans connect an outcome to the operation that caused it.
lines: Open the trace to see retrieval, answer composition, and evaluation on one timeline.
Select retrieve documents.
Its attributes show that the baseline takes the first chunk and returns the models document, rather than the storage document the question needs.

title:
Keep the
context.
benefit: Jump from a recorded span to the Python that produced it.
lines: Open source jumps directly from the selected span to its Python code.
The prepared improvement ranks documents by matching question terms instead of taking the first chunk.
The same instrumentation measures both versions.

captions.text: Open source jumps directly from the selected span to its Python code.

title:
Change one
thing.
benefit: Run the ranked retrieval variant against the same question.
tag: SAME DEMO CASE · NEW RETRIEVAL STRATEGY
lines: Back in Runs, choose ranked retrieval and launch the improved variant.
It finds the storage document, and the correctness score becomes one.
Both attempts remain in local history, including their commands and recorded configuration.

captions.text: Back in Runs, choose ranked retrieval and launch the improved variant.

title:
Compare
before deciding.
benefit: Keep the baseline and improved result side by side.
tag: ONE DEMO CASE · NOT A MODEL BENCHMARK
lines: Select the baseline as a comparison and inspect the recorded metrics and evaluation events.
The baseline scores zero; the ranked version scores one.
This proves the change for our single demo case. A real release would need a representative evaluation dataset.

title:
Bring evidence
to the assistant.
benefit: Attach the run instead of copying logs between tools.
tag: CONTEXT HANDOFF · MODEL REQUEST NOT SENT
lines: Attach the run to the coding assistant to carry its evidence into a focused request.
With a configured model, you can ask for an explanation or a proposed patch.
Autonomous execution additionally requires tested tool support and Docker; changes are reviewed before applying.

title:
Train in
the same loop.
benefit: Parameters, job status, and learning curves stay connected.
lines: For model work, switch to Training, select the training command, and enter experiment parameters.
Start a small, real PyTorch regression job on the local CPU.
The IDE records learning curves, system measurements, and checkpoint references alongside the other runs.

captions.text: For model work, switch to Training, select the training command, and enter experiment parameters.
Start a small, real PyTorch regression job on the local CPU.
The IDE records learning curves, system measurements, and checkpoint references alongside the other runs.

title:
Resume with
a checkpoint.
benefit: Inspect the saved state and continue training without losing history.
lines: Inspect the loss curves, then open the saved checkpoint.
Choose it for resume, increase the total step count, and launch the continuation.
The resumed run continues from the saved state while the original experiment stays available for comparison.

captions.text: Inspect the loss curves, then open the saved checkpoint.

title:
Choose your
model endpoint.
benefit: Chat, streaming, tool calls, and embeddings are tested separately.
lines: When you are ready to use a model, add a local or HTTPS endpoint in Models.
Capability checks distinguish chat, streaming, tools, and embeddings.
This recording does not connect a model service or claim a language model quality result.

title:
Inspect the
retrieved context.
benefit: Preview chunks, ingest documents, retrieve, and evaluate from one panel.
tag: CONFIGURATION TOUR · QDRANT AND EMBEDDINGS REQUIRED
lines: The RAG panel extends this loop to document chunking, ingestion, retrieval, and dataset evaluation.
Configure Qdrant and an embedding connection to run that workflow.
Retrieved chunks and their provenance help you inspect what an answer was grounded in.

title:
Less switching.
More evidence.
lines: The benefit is a shorter engineering loop.
Run your code, inspect the evidence, compare the change, and continue training, all from the same local workspace.
